source: New York Fed Markets Data API <https://markets.newyorkfed.org/api/rates/unsecured/effr/search.json> and <https://markets.newyorkfed.org/api/rates/unsecured/effr/last/1.json>, unsecured reference rate EFFR
notes: New York Fed Markets Data API, unsecured reference rate EFFR, daily (business days), percent. One row per date with the rate, percentiles, target range and volume where the API gives them (records before 2016-03-01 carry intraDayLow/intraDayHigh/stdDeviation instead of percentiles and volume; before 2008-12-16 a single target in targetRateFrom). 2003-07-20 is a Sunday record identical to 2003-07-21, kept as returned. observation_status = revisionIndicator, status_comments = footnoteId, as returned (empty -> null). Not FRED (Proposed ADR-0006). Re-queryable; the NY Fed revises only on the same day except in extraordinary circumstances, but each run's raw responses are kept (append_only_snapshot) and revisions against the previous run are warned. published_at = next EFFR date + 1 day 23:59:59 Asia/Karachi in UTC (basis effr_next_business_day_plus_1d); latest row: fetch date 23:59:59 PKT (basis effr_latest_row_fetch_date). Showing the EFFR to users requires the NY Fed reference-rate notice (extra.reference_rate_notice).
